scope.description: Monster-target ordinary/critical number glyphs, target-relative anchor, queue fan-out/cadence, TweenMax visual key points, global combo threshold/placement, 2/9/10/99/100 layouts, five-frame combo digit pulse, unchanged-count reset and P1/P2 source invariance. Player/pet incoming, heal and MP numbers are excluded.

provenance.locator: FFDec 26 XML: character 299 -> shape 298; num0..9 five-frame matrices and blur filters; asset frameRate=24.
beMagicAttack success/miss/crit/damage/reduceHp/event order; addMonHurtMc target anchor and resource routing.
checkAttack attackId/target deduplication before beMagicAttack and sourceRole forwarding.
step drives CureHpQueue once per host tick.
Pet basic attack creates a bullet whose sourceRole is the BasePet instance.
Direct effect ticks reduce monster HP and call addMonHurtMc without the direct-hit combo increment.
queue caps, five-item fan-out, two-tick damage cadence and ANumber creation in gameSence.
20px damage stride, 4x->1x 0.2s pop, 0.25s delay, 100px/1s rise+fade+destroy; 50px combo stride.
MonsterIsBeat consumer, combo>=2 panel, fixed anchor, 2s fade, 40-tick unchanged reset and maximum update.
1/2/3+ digit x anchors and num MovieClip layout.
Static current and biggest combo owners.
Representative magic-weapon bullet sets its sourceRole to the owning hero before shared monster hit resolution.

states.entry: Successful P1 Role hit; ordinary 42 appears at pop start.
Same ordinary hit after the 0.2s pop settles.
Successful P1 pet hit at rise/fade delay boundary; source does not change glyphs.
Successful magic-weapon/hero-owned critical hit uses bnum glyphs.
P2 pet hit shares the target-relative world anchor; halfway through rise/fade.
At tween completion the number is transparent and destroyed.
Six queued successful hits cause the first five to fan out in one tick; one remains queued.
A successful lethal hit still renders its final clamped damage before dead visual cleanup.
Dodge/miss returns before combo increment and damage-number enqueue.
An already resolved attackId is rejected before BaseMonster.beMagicAttack.
Original accepts and displays computed 0 after a successful hit; TASK-SLICE-212 intentionally tightens this to actual HP decrease only.
A direct BaseAddEffect tick can reduce monster HP and show an ordinary number without incrementing User.batterNum.
Combo panel at value 2, digit timeline frame 1/5.
Combo panel at value 2, digit timeline frame 2/5.
Combo panel at value 2, digit timeline frame 3/5.
Combo panel at value 2, digit timeline frame 4/5.
Combo panel at value 2, digit timeline frame 5/5.
Combo panel value 9; stable fifth digit frame before the five-frame MovieClip loops.
Combo panel value 10; stable fifth digit frame before the five-frame MovieClip loops.
Combo panel value 99; stable fifth digit frame before the five-frame MovieClip loops.
Combo panel value 100; stable fifth digit frame before the five-frame MovieClip loops.
P2 successful hits feed the same single global HUD panel; geometry is not mirrored.
At a 40-tick checkpoint with no growth since the previous checkpoint, combo resets to 0 and no panel is created.
